how_to_apply: Visit the official University website at www.iust.ac.in to apply online.
Ensure eligibility for the Project Assistant position as per the advertisement notice.
Submit the online application by the last date, 18.10.26.
Print the application form and gather all relevant documents and certificates.

Submit the hardcopies of application forms along with all relevant documents and certificates to the Office, Dept. of Electrical Engineering by 19.10.26. No other mode of application shall be accepted.
important_instructions: Only eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and called for interview in physical mode before the Selection Committee at the IUST, Awantipora campus. The Selection Committee reserves the right not to fill up the post in case the Committee didn't find any candidate suitable for the position. The engagement is purely temporary, performance-based and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate must join within 07 days from the date of issuance of the appointment order. The University reserves the right to cancel the post without assigning any reason. In case a selected candidate wishes to resign before completion of the engagement, a one-month notice or one month's emoluments in lieu thereof shall be required. No TA/DA shall be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: IUST Project Assistant Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Project Assistant position under the research project titled "Design & Deployment of Smart Weather Stations for Hyperlocal Data-Driven Precision Horticulture in J&K".

rows.qualification_required: Essential Qualification: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering (EE)/Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or an allied discipline with 55% or equivalent percentage of marks. Desirable: Practical experience in IoT System Development, Embedded System Programming, and Python.

content_sections.heading: IUST Project Assistant Salary
content_sections.text: Payment of salary is subject to release of funds by the funding agency.

content_sections.heading: IUST Project Assistant Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and called for an interview in physical mode before the Selection Committee at the IUST, Awantipora campus.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original documents regarding qualifications, experience, publications etc. (to be brought at the time of interview) Hardcopies of application form along with relevant documents and certificates for offline submission by 19.10.26

content_sections.heading: IUST Project Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and called for interview in physical mode before the Selection Committee at the IUST, Awantipora campus. The Selection Committee reserves the right not to fill up the post in case the Committee didn't find any candidate suitable for the position. The engagement is purely temporary, performance-based and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate must join within 07 days from the date of issuance of the appointment order. The University reserves the right to cancel the post without assigning any reason. In case a selected candidate wishes to resign before completion of the engagement, a one-month notice or one month's emoluments in lieu thereof shall be required. No TA/DA shall be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IUST Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Department of Electrical Engineering, Islamic University of Science and Technology, for hiring 01 Project Assistant under a JKST&IC-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under IUST Project Assistant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IUST Project Assistant 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 18.10.26, and the last date for submitting hardcopies to the Department of Electrical Engineering is 19.10.26.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for IUST Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering (EE)/Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or an allied discipline with 55% or equivalent percentage of marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IUST Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The upper and lower age limits are not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IUST Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for IUST Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the University website (www.iust.ac.in) by 18.10.26, and submit hardcopies of the application form with certificates to the Office, Dept. of Electrical Engineering by 19.10.26.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IUST Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates based on merit will be called for an interview in physical mode before the Selection Committee at the IUST, Awantipora campus.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for IUST Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive ₹20,000/- plus HRA (as admissible) per month.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The day, date, and time of the interview will be displayed on the University website along with the shortlisted list of candidates.
